question: In a certain code language, 'FATHER' is written as 'REHTAF', and 'COUPLE' is written as 'ELPUOC'. How will 'REMAIN' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

** All the letter are arranged in backwards order such that,**

 
• **First letter is placed at 6th **
 
• **Second letter is placed at 5th**
 
• **Third letter is placed at 4th**
 
• **Fourth letter is placed at 3rd**
 
• **Fifth letter is placed at 2nd**
 
• **Sixth letter is placed at 1st​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3a532a3759217d253be2f732a2a9a6b274c7dd4e229e304aba7bc981191bf0e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/def687e5ba1ecc55c7163a3caa2f48898281f2f0cd68737dfde73efc05a654a5.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c5ccadea7436ced5e92c0b012d0fc4780f5d1931549d478c752defa5b064dc4.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
